name: edshav
description: Harness-agnostic skills for specs, issue planning, code-change tracing and multi-PR coordination, plus a read-only Telegram plugin, a djinni.co job-search scraper and a Claude Code time log.

plugins.name: reader-test
plugins.description: Finds the errors in a spec, plan or estimate that its own author cannot see.

plugins.name: lanes
plugins.description: Runs a multi-PR effort as one coordinator session plus parallel lane sessions, with the state that outlives sessions kept in files.

plugins.name: generate-tasks-json
plugins.description: Plans a milestone as a tasks.json of Features and sub-issues and batch-creates them as GitHub issues with the bundled create-issues.js.

plugins.name: mutation-analyzer
plugins.description: Traces how data flows across layers and what breaks if you change it, anchored in actual code paths.

plugins.name: find-skills
plugins.description: Discovers and installs agent skills from the open skills ecosystem (npx skills, skills.sh). Copied from vercel-labs/skills, MIT.

plugins.name: telegram
plugins.description: Read-only Telegram for your own account: list, search and read chats and public channels.

plugins.name: djinni
plugins.description: Politely scrape a djinni.co job search into one Markdown file and analyse the postings.

plugins.name: timelog
plugins.description: Hours from your Claude Code sessions, per project directory, confirmed by you into a CSV time log.
